correctness.rationale: Independently regenerated all 156 facets from six Köhler–Lutz 13:3 affine orbits, constructed complete faces and links, and checked f=(13,78,286,533,468,156). For 533 tetrahedra links are connected cycles of sizes 3:91,4:195,5:195,6:52. Short links split into three affine orbits (13,39,39), with the 13-block orbit covering all 78 vertex pairs once; hence a 2-(13,4,1) projective plane of order three. Independently enumerated all candidates for each i=1,...,5, tested absent complementary simplex and full link equals its boundary; none qualifies. This finite test is exhaustive for precisely this labeled 13-vertex complex, not an inference about arbitrary triangulations. Script independently recomputed the claimed census; existing package verification script was read but not trusted as sole proof.
residual_risks: Only excludes positive-index moves in the given labeled complex. No claim to uniqueness, PL-minimality, or sequences after new vertex insertion; finite algorithm must act on all actual facets.
